title: ZielTakt Assistant
subtitle: Automated assistant · replies instantly
greeting: Hi! 👋 I'm the ZielTakt assistant. I can answer questions about websites, Google visibility, pricing and how we work. What can I help you with?
footnote: Automated answers. To talk to a person: WhatsApp or book an intro call.
fallback: Sorry, I didn't quite get that. Pick a topic below – or leave your contact details and Zakaria will get back to you personally.

intents.label: Hello
intents.answer: Hello and welcome! How can I help? For example: what does a website cost, how do I get found on Google, or how fast can you deliver?

intents.label: Pricing
intents.answer:
Our packages are called ZielTakt Komplett – a one-time setup plus a fixed monthly fee:

• Start: €790 + €149/month (CH: CHF 990 + CHF 179)
• Pro: €1,490 + €349/month (CH: CHF 1,890 + CHF 399) – most popular
• Partner: €2,900 + €590–790/month + ad budget (CH: CHF 3,490 + CHF 690–890)

The monthly fee covers hosting, security, small changes and – depending on the package – Google Profile care and reports. 12-month minimum term. No VAT is charged (§ 19 UStG, German small business rule).

intents.label: Which package fits?
intents.answer:
In short:

• Start – you finally want a professional online presence: website up to 3 pages, Google Profile, WhatsApp & call buttons.
• Pro – you want to be found and booked on Google: up to 7 pages, online booking, local SEO, automatic review requests, monthly report.
• Partner – you want to grow actively and find staff: everything in Pro plus Google/Meta ads, lead automation and a careers page.

We'll work out which one really fits in a free 15-minute intro call.

intents.label: Services
intents.answer:
We build a complete system for local businesses instead of just a website:

• Website – modern, fast on mobile, built to bring enquiries
• Google – Business Profile, local SEO, Google Maps
• Enquiries & bookings – WhatsApp button, online booking, forms
• Reviews – automatically ask happy customers for Google reviews
• Measure & grow – see where your customers come from

intents.label: Get found on Google
intents.answer:
Most customers search "service + town" on Google today. To show up there, we take care of:

• your Google Business Profile (categories, services, photos, opening hours)
• a fast website with the right terms for your town
• reviews – they often decide who customers call

To be honest: nobody can guarantee position 1. What we guarantee: everything Google wants to see from a local business is set up properly.

intents.label: More Google reviews
intents.answer:
Most businesses have happy customers – but nobody asks them for a review. We automate it: after the job, your customer gets a short message with a direct link to your Google profile. One click, done.

Included in the Pro package, or on its own from €300.

intents.label: WhatsApp & online booking
intents.answer:
Many enquiries get lost because nobody can pick up the phone. So your website gets:

• a WhatsApp button with a pre-filled message
• one-tap calling on mobile
• 24/7 online booking (from the Pro package)
• if you like: every new enquiry sent to you instantly via WhatsApp or email

intents.label: Finding staff
intents.answer: Good people look at your online presence first. In the Partner package we build a careers page for your openings and, if you like, run targeted Google and Meta (Instagram/Facebook) ads in your region. You pay the ad budget directly to Google or Meta.

intents.label: How fast is it?
intents.answer:
Depending on the package:

• Start: approx. 7 days
• Pro: 2–3 weeks
• Partner: 3–4 weeks

The clock starts once we have your content (texts, photos, logo) – and of course we help you with that.

intents.label: How does it work?
keywords: what do you need from me
what do i need to provide
intents.answer:
Here's how it works:

1. Get to know you – free 15-minute call
2. Concept & design – you see everything in advance and give feedback
3. Build – fast, secure, mobile-optimised
4. Launch – the site goes live, Google is set up, you get a short walkthrough

All we need from you is info about your business and a few photos.

intents.label: Contract & term
intents.answer: Before we start you get a fixed written quote: services and all costs in black and white. No hidden costs. The minimum term is 12 months; after that you can cancel monthly.

intents.label: Changes & maintenance
intents.answer: Hosting, SSL, security updates and small changes are included in every monthly package – just send us a message. If you like, you can also change texts, images and appointments yourself.

intents.label: Clients in Switzerland
intents.answer: Yes, gladly. We're in Konstanz, right on the border, and work with businesses on both sides. All prices are also available in CHF – e.g. the Pro package: CHF 1,890 + CHF 399/month.

intents.label: English & other languages
intents.answer: We advise you in English, German or Arabic. Your website can be in German, English or several languages – for example German/Arabic, like the Abeer Beauty Center.

intents.label: References
intents.answer:
Two recent projects:

• Auto Kosmetik Swissline (Konstanz) – website with its own brand identity and direct booking requests
• Abeer Beauty Center – bilingual German/Arabic website with contact form

You'll find both in the Projects section with a link to the live site.

intents.label: Chatbot & automation
intents.answer: We can build an assistant like this one for your website too: it answers the most common questions instantly, even at night, and takes enquiries. From €750. More automations: every new enquiry sent to you via WhatsApp instantly (from €250), automatic review requests (from €300), reminders so no enquiry gets lost (from €400).

intents.label: Who is ZielTakt?
intents.answer: ZielTakt is a digital growth studio from Konstanz on Lake Constance. Behind ZielTakt is Zakaria Haidar – you always talk to him directly, no call centre. We work with businesses in Germany and Switzerland, in person or remotely, in English, German or Arabic.

intents.label: Book an intro call
intents.answer:
The quickest ways:

• Book a free 15-minute intro call online
• or message us on WhatsApp
• or leave your details here – Zakaria usually gets back to you the same day.

intents.label: Thanks
intents.answer: You're welcome! If you like, we can go through everything else in a free 15-minute call.
